Where the savings often are

LED is only half the story.

The fitting reduces how much electricity the light uses. The controls reduce how long you pay for it.

🚶

Occupancy

Switch or dim lighting automatically when corridors, carparks or warehouse aisles are vacant.

🌓

Dimming

Maintain useful background light (e.g. 30%) for safety without paying for 100% output during quiet hours.

⏱️

Timing

Stop exterior, carpark and common-area lighting running longer than required during daylight hours.

Why the room comes first

Better lighting is not more light. It is the right light in the right place.

Good lighting changes how a facility behaves: warehouse aisles that forklift drivers can safely navigate, carparks that feel secure, and common areas that don't burn electricity at 2am.

The fitting matters, but controls do more of the financial work. A quality high-bay left running 24/7 still wastes thousands of dollars a year.

One team to plan, supply and install your lighting.
